title: NexaVM Hypervisor Integrate Veeam backup agentless
description: Veeam agentless backup integration with NexaVM Hypervisor
content:
We are excited to announce that NexaVM Hypervisor will officially release the integration with Veeam agentless backup and recovery. 

Thanks to NexaVM Open and well structured API the integration process was smooth and backup performance is very good. 

The release date will be mid of May 2026.
